title: How many machines?
summary: A coffee shop can open one to five tills. Let a search try each number with repeated runs and pick the one that cuts the wait most while keeping every till busy enough.
origin: Written for this project: the coffee shop (spec 1's example) with tills searched, as spec 2's machine-count benchmark (benchmarks/machine_count), with answers from Erlang C (docs/research/spec-4-template-sources.md).
